procedure: Reserve included allowance, freeze the reviewed public head, and admit only PR 1.
Manually run the complete check job and preview deployment on that head.
Run the shell/typed-health flow once on GitHub and once locally; retain the local recording.
Capture owned Worker, namespace, binding and deployment/version metadata using read-only calls.
Disable deployment, close the PR once, and let automatic trusted-base cleanup execute.
Compare the post-cleanup inventory to the private baseline and validate owned identities absent.
Drain earlier runs, release admission, reopen the draft PR and observe automatic merge-revision checks with preview skipped.
Package only public-safe evidence, preserve hashes and distinguish every execution revision.
expected_result: Manual preview and production health flow succeed; closing the PR removes only owned resources; pre-existing retained metadata is preserved; automatic PR checks pass with deployment disabled.
